futures.volume_oi_net.semantic_note: OI is position stock at a point in time; day/night net trading is interval flow. Do not subtract one from the other or label the difference as opposing positions.

options.volume_oi_institutional_net.semantic_note: Call/Put volume, OI and day/night net trades are all contract counts but represent different measures. options.instOpt is contract flow; options.instOptForce is amount in NT$ 100M.

options.gex.net_gross_per_strike.canonical_unit: NT$ (gamma × OI × contract multiplier × underlying price² × 1%)
options.gex.net_gross_per_strike.semantic_note: OI-based Black-Scholes Gamma exposure estimate; Call/Put sign convention is a model assumption, not verified dealer inventory. Net GEX sign is not a directional bullish/bearish signal and is excluded from Bias until a validated directional rule exists.

synthesis.bias.semantic_note: Bias uses active directional factors only; GEX remains visible as a model exposure metric but is not a directional score.

synthesis.factor_count.semantic_note: Count only factors with validated inputs and active scoring; disabled GEX is not included in the active count.

synthesis.correlation.semantic_note: Pearson coefficient in [-1,+1], dimensionless; use only observations dated on or before DATA_REPORT T0 and require at least 5 complete samples.

history.similarity_outcomes.source_unit: next-day index return (%) from historical similar days
history.similarity_outcomes.canonical_unit: percentage return; separate positive/negative outcome rates
history.similarity_outcomes.display_unit: 隔日平均變動 %；隔日上漲比例 %；隔日下跌比例 %
history.similarity_outcomes.semantic_note: Positive/negative outcome ratios are descriptive frequencies, not strategy win rate unless direction and execution rules are defined. Historical query must exclude rows on or after the as-of T0.

technical.indicators.canonical_unit: RSI14 and stochastic are indicator values; MACD histogram in index points; moving-average deviation in %
technical.indicators.display_unit: 依指標量綱分別顯示；缺少足夠 T0 以前樣本時 unavailable
technical.indicators.semantic_note: All source records are filtered to Asia/Taipei T0 before calculating RSI, MACD, KD, SMA and five-day series.
